key_points: Reduce max position size to 5% of budget per trade to improve liquidity
Implement ATR-based stop losses with 1.5 ATR distance
Only enter trades on clear opening-range breakouts or VWAP bounces with volume >1.5x average
Require 50-day moving average above price for long entries; for shorts allow mean-reversion below MA
Limit daily trades to 3 and max open positions to 3
Increase conviction threshold to 5 for new entries
Use tighter stop loss 0.5% to 1% and target 2% to 3% with half position scaling out
Avoid trading in last 30 minutes; close all positions 15 minutes before market close
implementation_steps: Review and adjust risk parameters in trading engine
Backtest ATR stop loss and entry filters on past 6 months data
Train team on new entry criteria and real-time liquidity monitoring
Set up alerts for VWAP bounce and OR breakout with rvol >1.5
Monitor execution slippage and adjust position sizing accordingly
